content:
**结论**：官方Linux/U-Boot源码未见UPD目录`0x14`字段到RAM（`slram0/1`等）的映射表或装填实现。

### 一、逐项新证据与上下文核验
1. **平台MTD/MMC/块设备分区定义**：
   - [pvc04v-MC8241.dts](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/oss_refresh_20261009/es_kernel/linux-4.19.124/arch/arm64/boot/dts/socionext/pvc04v-MC8241.dts#L97-L115)、[pvc04v-MC8266.dts](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/oss_refresh_20261009/linux-4.19.124/arch/arm64/boot/dts/socionext/pvc04v-MC8266.dts#L97-L115)：仅含禁用模板`nor_mem@20000000`单分区`nor-top`（`reg=<0 0x1000000>`）；`:198-219`启用`sd0@19830000`、禁用`emmc@19810000`，均无分区子节点。
   - [pvc04v-MC8241.dtsi](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/oss_refresh_20261009/es_kernel/linux-4.19.124/arch/arm64/boot/dts/socionext/pvc04v-MC8241.dtsi#L709-L744)：`nand-controller@19800000`禁用且仅`nand-1`空节点，`emmc@19810000`无分区表。
   - U-Boot [pvc04v-MC8241.dtsi](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/u-boot/u-boot/arch/arm/dts/pvc04v-MC8241.dtsi#L121-L133)仅禁用`sd1/sd2`；[sc2006a-evb.h](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/u-boot/u-boot/include/configs/sc2006a-evb.h#L23-L35)为EVB通用`fatload mmc 0`至`0x48xxxxxxx`。
   - [drivers/block/ipcu.c](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/kernel_selected/linux-4.19.124/drivers/block/ipcu.c#L43-L60)、[L173-L192](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/kernel_selected/linux-4.19.124/drivers/block/ipcu.c#L173-L192)：`vblk-rtos`经IPCU `VBLK_GETGEO=0x3000`动态取扇区数，无静态分区表且DTS未实例化。
2. **`slram`消费者与生产者缺口**：
   - [pvc04v-MC8241.dts](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/oss_refresh_20261009/es_kernel/linux-4.19.124/arch/arm64/boot/dts/socionext/pvc04v-MC8241.dts#L30)声明`slram0,0x4012A0000,+0x00400000,slram1,0x4016A0000,+0x02060000`；[slram
<truncated 691 bytes>
0x401290000`/`slram0/1`的前级生产者代码。
3. **数值字面量全量检索与上下文排除**：
   - 扫描[linux-4.19.124.tar.gz](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/linux-4.19.124.tar.gz)（61993文件）与[u-boot](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/u-boot/u-boot)（15224文件，含NT包）中目录58个`0x14`值（`>=0x20000`）及RAM低/全位字面量：
   - `0x2d40000`：均0命中。
   - `0x3d40000`：U-Boot 0命中；Linux 4处读上下文均为异构平台（`kirkwood-openblocks_a7.dts:176` Marvell NAND分区长度、`mach-pxa/zylonite.c:353`与`littleton.c:316` PXA NAND `MassStorage`长度、`arch/parisc/kernel/perf_images.h:2883` PA-RISC掩码）。
   - `0x80000`（平台范围）：[pvc04v-MC8241.dtsi](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/oss_refresh_20261009/es_kernel/linux-4.19.124/arch/arm64/boot/dts/socionext/pvc04v-MC8241.dtsi#L90)、[L934](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/oss_refresh_20261009/es_kernel/linux-4.19.124/arch/arm64/boot/dts/socionext/pvc04v-MC8241.dtsi#L934)为GICR与XM6寄存器窗长度；[sni_dsp_drv_m20v.c](file://<LOCAL_WORKSPACE>/analysis/sources/kernel_selected/linux-4.19.124/drivers/snidsp/sni_dsp_drv_m20v.c#L930)（及`karine.c:460`）为注释态XM6 TCM DMA拷贝长度；`netsec_drv.c:133,171,2286,2654`为网卡中断位。
   - `0x12A0000`/`0x16A0000`/`0x2060000`：除`MC8241/8266.dts:30`外，仅命中无关架构（`mscc,jr2.dtsi:227`、`fsl-ls1028a.dtsi:192`、`drxj_map.h:4431`）。

### 二、覆盖边界與下一动作
- **边界**：仅排除上述开源包内静态字面量与DTS分区表；不排除移位/算术动态计算或闭源RTOS/前级加载器中的映射；不因`0x14`连续性定死物理单位，不将高熵直接定为AES。
- **下一动作**：在已解包非高熵组件（如`01_loader1.bin`等）中静态检索`0x400180000`/`0x400200000`/`0x4012A0000`高/低位立即数及目录字段消费指令，定位前级装载逻辑。
